newsitem.title: UK: UK'S BATM signs jv with C. Perkins of U.S.
newsitem.headline: UK'S BATM signs jv with C. Perkins of U.S.

text.p: British data communications firm BATM Advanced Communications said on Tuesday it had signed a joint venture with Canoga Perkins, a U.S. telecommunications company.

The venture will make a new range of products in the "brandwidth on demand" segment. There will be a second generation range to BATM's existing EtherSpan products which enable ethernet users to communicate over a wide area network at the full ethernet local area network speed.
BATM said the new products would incorporate ATM functionality as well as ethernet and would include new technologies currently under development.
The company said it would bear only a proportion of the research and development costs for these products.
"The partners expect the new products, which are due to be launched in the autumn of 1998, to be marketed by major U.S. telephone companies to their customers," BATM said.
